#### Veeam

**Licenses**

This dashboard gives visibility into Licenses in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique hosts, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces license editions and days remaining. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a license-operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
